name: Acoustic Campaign
description: Acoustic Campaign provides email, SMS, push, automation, contacts, programs, events, and relational marketing-data APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect customer-owned pod-bound OAuth credentials. Relay pins three REST operations: one exact program read runs directly, while one exact database-contact read and one one-contact profile update require approval. Writes require recorded contact authorization and consent/subscription fields remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned application bound to a least-privilege user.

capabilities.label: Read contact
capabilities.description: Use one exact database-contact lookup with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one contact
capabilities.description: Update allowlisted profile fields for one authorized contact with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Acoustic Campaign contact
approvalRequired.description: Update allowlisted profile fields for one authorized contact.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials, access tokens, authorization headers, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk transfers
blocked.description: Database/list enumeration, contact collections, imports, exports, relational-table loads, and unbounded transfers are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer messaging
blocked.description: Email, SMS, push, in-app, programs, campaigns, content, events, lists, databases, deletes, consent, and subscription-state changes remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only three pinned REST routes run on an enumerated pod origin; arbitrary paths, pods, queries, headers, profile structures, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Exact program reads run directly; exact contact reads and one-contact profile updates require approval, and writes require contact authorization while consent/subscription fields remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All three selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; contact authorization, fixed pod routing, field/response bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin/consent blocks remain enforced.
